pals.name: Green Slime
pals.summary: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm. Partner Skill : Slime Body

pals.name: Blue Slime
pals.summary: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm. Partner Skill : Slime Body

pals.name: Red Slime
pals.summary: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm. Partner Skill : Slime Body

pals.name: Purple Slime
pals.summary: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm. Partner Skill : Slime Body

pals.name: Illuminant Slime
pals.summary: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm. Partner Skill : Slime Body

pals.name: Rainbow Slime
pals.summary: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm. Partner Skill : Slime Body

pals.name: Enchanted Sword
pals.summary: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm. Partner Skill : Enchant

pals.name: Cave Bat
pals.summary: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm. Partner Skill : Bat Backup

pals.name: Illuminant Bat
pals.summary: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm. Partner Skill : Bat Backup

pals.name: Eye of Cthulhu
pals.summary: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm. Partner Skill : Mad Eye Lunge

pals.name: Demon Eye
pals.summary: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm. Partner Skill : Demonic Sight

pals.name: Chikipi
pals.summary: Extremely weak and far too delicious. It is one of the weakest Pals alongside Lamball . No matter how many are hunted, they just keep appearing. Partner Skill : Egg Layer

pals.name: Teafant
pals.summary: Large amounts of water pour from what is thought to be its nose, though some say that it is, in fact, just snot. This has sparked a fierce debate among Pal scholars. Partner Skill : Soothing Shower

pals.name: Vixy
pals.summary: The idol of Palpagos Island. If you bully a Vixy , you best be prepared to become enemies with the whole world. Partner Skill : Dig Here!

pals.name: Lamball
pals.summary: Partner Skill :

pals.name: Mau
pals.summary: Its hard tail does not deteriorate even when cut off. Some believed these severed tails bring good luck, but for the innumerable Mau who were poached as a result, they were anything but. Partner Skill : Gold Digger

pals.name: Jolthog
pals.summary: It releases the electricity stored in its body when under attack. The voltage it generates exceeds 10 million volts, making it more lethal than any conventional heavy firearms when thrown. Partner Skill : Jolt Bomb

pals.name: Lifmunk
pals.summary: Intelligent as a five to seven-year-old human child. It makes a wonderful partner, but there have been more than a few cases where they've killed their master after learning to use weapons. Partner Skill : Lifmunk Recoil

pals.name: Sparkit
pals.summary: During the dry season, this Pal is always on the verge of blowing a fuse. Sparks can fly with even the slightest provocation, even amongst allies. Partner Skill : Static Electricity

pals.name: Depresso
pals.summary: It has few friends because of the perpetually grouchy look on its face, but it is in fact kindhearted. Some have seen it feeding Vixy who have strayed from their pack. Partner Skill : Caffeine Inoculation

pals.name: Foxparks
pals.summary: It is unskilled at controlling fire from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the flames it breathes unintentionally. Foxparks sneezes are one of the leading causes of forest fires. Partner Skill : Huggy Fire

pals.name: Fuack
pals.summary: Using its own body water, this Pal can create waves anywhere. It body surfs when in a hurry, but the resulting speed often ends in a fatal collision. Partner Skill : Surfing Slam

pals.name: Clovee
pals.summary: Some individuals once had three or more leaves on their foreheads. Regarded as symbols of good fortune, those with more leaves were heavily hunted, leading the species to evolve fewer leaves over time. Partner Skill : Happy Clover

pals.name: Pengullet

spawns.location: Sealed Realm of the Frozen Wings 114,-352

pals.summary: The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, but sadly, its desire to fly has remained as strong as ever. Even now, it tries to fly again in any way it can. Partner Skill : Pengullet Launcher

pals.name: Gumoss
pals.summary: Partner Skill :

pals.name: Hoocrates
pals.summary: Often lost in thought, it sometimes finds it difficult to sleep. |I think, therefore I am.| Partner Skill : Dark Knowledge

pals.name: Pupperai
pals.summary: Pupperai territorial disputes begin with a staredown and end in a single, quick strike. Training them to |stay| is risky business, as the |go| command triggers that same attack instinct. Partner Skill : Best Boy

pals.name: Nox
pals.summary: If you find Nox hair in your bedding, you should leave it where it lays and leave immediately. Picking it up is a one-way-ticket to a never ending night. Partner Skill : Kuudere

pals.name: Daedream
pals.summary: It puts those it is interested in to sleep and shows them an endless stream of happy dreams. Those who fall under its spell are never to wake until death takes them. Partner Skill : Dream Chaser

pals.name: Tanzee
pals.summary: Long ago, this Pal used long objects like tree branches as weapons. After coming into contact with humans, however, it found something slightly more effective: guns. Partner Skill : Cheery Rifle

pals.name: Cremis
pals.summary: Compared to Lamball , it has finer wool and a temperament more suited for domestication. However, it has historically always been kept as a pet. Cuteness is considered a virtue. Partner Skill : Fluffy Wool

pals.name: Rushoar
pals.summary: Being an extremely aggressive Pal, it often picks fights before gauging its opponents' strength. Though small, its powerful charge can even send boulders flying. Partner Skill : Hard Head

pals.name: Rooby
pals.summary: Wild Rooby surprisingly never get sick. Eating one piece of charcoal a day, made by burning a branch, is the secret to its eternal health. Partner Skill : Tiny Spark

pals.name: Ribbuny
pals.summary: A Pal that's never without a bright smile. Occasionally, its tentacles get tied up in knots by Cattiva 's pranks. During those moments, its expression turns demonic. Partner Skill : Happy-Go-Lucky Bunny

pals.name: Jolthog Cryst
pals.summary: It releases the cold air stored in its body when under attack. The frigid blast it radiates is cold enough to freeze the surrounding air and easily pierces through any attacker's body. Partner Skill : Cold Bomb

pals.name: Swee
pals.summary: Crawling along the ground, it eats microscopic organic matter. After a while, it discharges any substances that provide no nutrition. By using it as a mop for cleaning, everyone wins! Partner Skill : Fluffy

pals.name: Tanzee Ignis
pals.summary: Its palms have evolved to handle burning objects without getting scorched. When its gun runs out of ammo, it may grab the heated barrel with its bare hands and use it to club its foes. Partner Skill : Chipper Chimp Gunfire

pals.name: Woolipop
pals.summary: Its entire body is 18,000 times sweeter than sugar. Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent will find themselves overwhelmed by sweetness and even pass out should they take a bite of this Pal. Partner Skill : Candy Pop

pals.name: Kelpsea
pals.summary: Its personality changes depending on the quality of the water it was born into. Kelpsea born into polluted waters are generally ill-tempered and quickly become delinquents. Partner Skill : Aqua Spout

pals.name: Mozzarina
pals.summary: Milk pours from this Pal like water from an open faucet, regardless of its gender. It's truly a mystery of life, although this mystery may be better left unsolved. Partner Skill : Milk Maker

pals.name: Fuddler
pals.summary: Its large claws boast of diamond-like hardness. However, sharpening these claws consumes most of its energy, leading it to sometimes spending entire days doing nothing else. Partner Skill : Mining Assistance

pals.name: Hangyu
pals.summary: Its gigantic arms can rip apart even iron. As a particularly cruel form of execution, serious criminals would be strung up in a public square, and a Hangyu would tear the skin right from their bones. Partner Skill : Flying Trapeze

pals.name: Killamari
pals.summary: It wraps itself around an enemy's head, sucking out their insides. Pal mummies are occasionally found, but these are in fact Killamari victims. Partner Skill : Fried Squid

pals.name: Cattiva
pals.summary: Partner Skill :

pals.name: Mau Cryst
pals.summary: Its crystalline tail is beautiful, but shatters when this Pal dies. Some believe it is good luck to raise them, so Mau Cryst in captivity are treated with great care. Partner Skill : Icy Whispers

pals.name: Celaray
pals.summary: Riding the wind, this Pal travels where it pleases. Should it find a partner along the way, the encounter will mark its journey's end. Partner Skill : Zephyr Glider

pals.name: Tocotoco

spawns.location: Map Sealed Realm of the Swift 349,-2

pals.summary: A frightening Pal that produces exploding eggs. It often fires these eggs from its rear end as a form of defense, but when spent, the Pal itself explodes. Partner Skill : Eggbomb Launcher

pals.name: Melpaca
pals.summary: Don't be fooled by this Pal's fluffy appearance. A hypersonic kick from one of its long legs may send you flying to the other side of the world. Partner Skill : Pacapaca Wool

pals.name: Eikthyrdeer
pals.summary: The one who possesses the most impressive antlers becomes the leader of the herd. If their antlers are broken, they become depressed and leave the herd never to be seen again. Partner Skill : Guardian of the Forest

pals.name: Flambelle
pals.summary: When it starts crying, this Pal produces magma in place of tears. The magma that pours out is absorbed back into its body, causing it to get hotter and hotter. The more it cries, the stronger it becomes. Partner Skill : Magma Tears

pals.name: Bristla
pals.summary: This prickly Pal's thorns are highly poisonous. It is friendly with Cinnamoth and only smiles while a Cinnamoth is drinking its nectar. Partner Skill : Princess Gaze

pals.name: Direhowl
pals.summary: Long ago Direhowl would hunt alongside humans but over the years this bond faded. Partner Skill : Direhowl Rider

pals.name: Leezpunk

spawns.location: Map Sealed Realm of the Frozen Wings 162,-280

pals.summary: Partner Skill :

pals.name: Flopie
pals.summary: It prefers places that have an abundance of vegetation, but hay fever has apparently become a problem for Flopie as of late. Partner Skill : Helper Bunny

pals.name: Jelliette
pals.summary: A Pal that closely resembles Jellroy . It’s very social, so when plans overlap, it asks its good friend Jellroy to go in its place. As thanks, one date. Partner Skill : Jelliette Drop

pals.name: Leezpunk Ignis
pals.summary: A Pal that has an unusual obsession with their standing posture. Always in search of the hottest pose, this Pal's owner is constantly presented with fervent stances. Partner Skill : Too Cool to be Seen

pals.name: Herbil
pals.summary: When in doubt, punch it till it works—that’s Herbil 's approach to fixing things. With strength perfectly tuned for humans, sometimes just one punch is enough to restart a stopped heart. Partner Skill : Herbil Pulse

pals.name: Cinnamoth
pals.summary: Sniffing its scales produces a feeling of unparalleled euphoria. There was some effort to further regulate this byproduct, but the Free Pal Alliance have vehemently opposed these measures, putting a stop to them. Partner Skill : Mysterious Scales

pals.name: Caprity
pals.summary: The shrub on this Pal's back produces berries as long as it is properly fed. It offers these berries to potential mates, and if the flavor is to their liking, romance blossoms. Partner Skill : Berry Picker

pals.name: Croajiro
pals.summary: Those who disgrace the honor of the herd are forced to take their own life. By piercing their inflated vocal sac with a tree branch, they are blown away into the atmosphere and return to the afterlife. Partner Skill : Leap Stance

pals.name: Jellroy
pals.summary: A Pal that closely resembles Jelliette . It sometimes appears as a substitute when Jelliette is unavailable. Its acting is so flawless that no one ever notices the switch. Partner Skill : Jellroy Drop

pals.name: Eikthyrdeer Terra
pals.summary: The individual with the hardest horns becomes the leader. Once the horns are lost, so too is its leadership status. It leaves the herd amidst farewell glances and quietly returns to the earth. Partner Skill : Guardian of the Golden Forest

pals.name: Galeclaw
pals.summary: A Pal that can easily take flight even while grasping a human. It is, however, prone to letting go when tired, which has led to the sudden demise of more than a few souls. Partner Skill : Galeclaw Glider

pals.name: Nitewing
pals.summary: It carries newborn Pals to its nest and raises them as a surrogate parent. Once the baby Pal has fattened up, it hunts them. Partner Skill : Travel Companion

pals.name: Gobfin
pals.summary: Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal. However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land. Since walking requires much energy, it gradually became smaller and is now a small and puny Pal. Partner Skill : Angry Shark

pals.name: Killamari Primo
pals.summary: It sinks its fangs into the enemy’s neck, draining every last drop of blood. When two Killamari Primo s latch onto each other, they become locked in a relentless struggle—each trying to suck the other dry until one withers away. Partner Skill : Fried Killamari

pals.name: Gloopie
pals.summary: Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal. Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like hickeys. One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some truly awkward misunderstandings. Partner Skill : Sticky Princess

pals.name: Amione
pals.summary: If one disappears, another simply shows up to take its place, and life goes on like nothing happened. For Amione , companionship is everything. Partner Skill : Magical Twin Powers

pals.name: Hangyu Cryst
pals.summary: Its gigantic arms can tear through blocks of ice. There were times when great sinners were tied in the town square and had their hair torn out by Hangyu Cryst as a brutal form of public humiliation. Partner Skill : Winter Trapeze

pals.name: Foxparks Cryst
pals.summary: It is unskilled at controlling cold air from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the frost it breathes unintentionally. When Foxparks Cryst catches a cold, its nasal discharge freezes, making it difficult to breathe and causing it to panic. Partner Skill : Huggy Frost

pals.name: Pengullet Lux
pals.summary: The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, and it can no longer fly. Yet its longing for the sky has turned to jealousy— so it harnessed electricity to strike down those who still soar. Partner Skill : Pengullet Lux Launcher

pals.name: Muffly
pals.summary: Its soft facial fluff softens any hit, but it cannot groom itself well nor scratch its itches, leaving it in a constant state of mild frustration. Partner Skill : Fluffy Flutterer

pals.name: Kelpsea Ignis
pals.summary: Its personality changes depending on the temperature of the water it was born into. Kelpsea born in warm waters generally have a passionate, motivated personality. Partner Skill : Lava Spout

pals.name: Ribbuny Botan
pals.summary: Always wears a cheerful smile. Sometimes, thanks to Cattiva 's pranks, they end up tangled in tentacles and have to fight their way out! Even in tough situations, they keep smiling cheerfully. Partner Skill : Ground 'n' Pound

pals.name: Finsider
pals.summary: It looks like something is peeking out from inside a costume, but even if you reach inside, there’s nothing there. In fact, you can keep reaching deeper and deeper. Perhaps the universe itself lies within. Partner Skill : Water Gun

pals.name: Surfent
pals.summary: Its hydrodynamic form is well suited for activities on water. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards. Partner Skill : Swift Swimmer

pals.name: Gobfin Ignis
pals.summary: Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal. However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land. Since walking burns many calories, it astonishingly awakened its power to control fire! Partner Skill : Angry Shark

pals.name: Needoll
pals.summary: Its spikes react to its emotions. A dearly cherished Needoll is something one may instinctively want to embrace. But more often than not, it ends in a tragic accident. Partner Skill : Hug Me Please

pals.name: Turtacle
pals.summary: To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell. Unfortunately, it's utterly defenseless underneath. Even a little tickle could knock it out cold. Partner Skill : Spikey Carrier

pals.name: Dazzi
pals.summary: Often kind to lonely Pals. However, the moment a Pal mistakes this for actual friendship, it seizes the opportunity to blast them with a thunderbolt. Partner Skill : Lady of Lightning

pals.name: Snugloo
pals.summary: “To look at a Snugloo 's eyes” is an expression which means to seek the unseen essence of things. Ironically, no researcher has ever confirmed whether Snugloo s have eyes in the first place. Partner Skill : Invisible Eye

pals.name: Celaray Lux
pals.summary: Its flashy patterns help it attract a partner. But after a long history of electrocution incidents involving Celaray Lux , yellow-and-black stripes are now seen across the island as a sign of danger. Partner Skill : Jolt Glider

pals.name: Cawgnito
pals.summary: Long ago it freely soared the skies. After losing a contest with Galeclaw , it abandoned the skies, and now lives a secretive life in the dark of night. Partner Skill : Eerie Nightstreaker

pals.name: Puffolt
pals.summary: Its fluffy fur absorbs tremendous amounts of water when soaked. Shaking it dry releases a powerful electrical discharge, making bath time together a serious gamble. Partner Skill : Crackle Booster

pals.name: Beegarde
pals.summary: A servant that pledges loyalty to Elizabee . Any that cause harm to the queen are immediately expelled from the hive. It will gladly give its life to protect its queen. Partner Skill : Worker Bee

pals.name: Tombat
pals.summary: Often appears out of the blue to flaunt its prized wings in front of other Pals. Although this appears to be an intimidation tactic, the Pal seems to derive some kind of pleasure from the display. Partner Skill : Ultrasonic Sensor

pals.name: Chillet
pals.summary: It can curl up its body and roll around at extremely high speeds. Long ago, people would tie bags of milk to domesticated Chillet as they grazed to produce butter using this spinning force. Partner Skill : Wriggling Weasel

pals.name: Arsox

spawns.location: Map Sealed Realm of the Frozen Wings 176,-308

pals.summary: In ancient times, carnivorous Pals pursued them relentlessly. The absurd fury in the cries of Arsox transformed into a raging inferno, which has been passed on to this day. Partner Skill : Warm Body

pals.name: Kikit
pals.summary: A decade ago, Kikit soccer was popular. However, it quickly fell out of favor due to fierce opposition from the Free Pal Alliance. Nevertheless, the Kikit 's themselves didn't mind because it helped shed their old carapace. Partner Skill : Sandball Soccer

pals.name: Fuack Ignis
pals.summary: With a belly built for friction, this Pal sparks flames as it body surfs. But when it gets carried away, it often ends up a rolling fireball. Partner Skill : Fire Tackle

pals.name: Dumud
pals.summary: When too relaxed, its reaction time drastically declines. Even if it were sliced from head to tail, it probably wouldn't even realize that it should be dead until the next morning. Partner Skill : Soil Improver

pals.name: Elphidran

spawns.location: Map Free Pal Alliance Tower Entrance 44,-284

pals.summary: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it is sometimes unable to discern good from evil, often allowing wrongdoers to take advantage of it. Partner Skill : Amicable Holy Dragon

pals.name: Univolt
pals.summary: It used to be considered an emissary of the Thunder God, and thus was not hunted by people. However, after witnesses observed one die from a lightning strike, its reverence faded, and it quite literally fell into the role of a workhorse. Partner Skill : Swift Deity

pals.name: Robinquill
pals.summary: A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the forests. It may prove to be a key for understanding what Pals are and how they diverged from humans in the distant past. Partner Skill : Grounded Archer

pals.name: Wispaw
pals.summary: The ghostly hands behind it embody the souls of all humans who have raised its kind. Lately, they seem to have reached a unanimous consensus to dote on Wispaw . Partner Skill : Death-Cheating Feline

pals.name: Finsider Ignis
pals.summary: Even if you reach into its mouth, there’s nothing inside—it just keeps going. Thinking it might be an interdimensional space, one researcher tried climbing in like a sleeping bag. But when the gag reflex kicked in, they realized... it’s definitely part of the creature’s body. Partner Skill : Ember Chamber

pals.name: Yakumo
pals.summary: It has a strong sense of justice and despises evil. In the past they were faithful and loving companions to the islanders. Nowadays, Yakumo s are hostile to humans wherever they spot them. Partner Skill : Birds of a Feather

pals.name: Kingpaca
pals.summary: Melpaca serve this Pal. Contests between Kingpaca offer up their vassals as a wager. Those seen alone are losers of such contests. Partner Skill : King of Muscles

pals.name: Dazemu
pals.summary: Take one step forward and forget your doubts. Take two steps forward and forget your worries. Take three steps forward and forget your fears. Face any enemy. Partner Skill : Sand Sprint

pals.name: Sweepa
pals.summary: While hibernating, a large number of Swee hide within its voluminous body hair. The most ever recorded is 101. Partner Skill : King of Fluff

pals.name: Gorirat
pals.summary: It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades. The meaning of each rhythm differs by troop, but the distinction between them is still largely unknown. Partner Skill : Full-Power Gorilla Mode

pals.name: Munchill
pals.summary: The inside of its mouth stays pleasantly cold, making it a natural fridge when closed. Its saliva contains enzymes that prevent food from rotting. Thus, it can serve as a food locker for humans— whether it is sanitary or not is another matter entirely. Partner Skill : Icy Maw

pals.name: Grintale

spawns.location: Map Sealed Realm of the Frozen Wings 175,-317

pals.summary: Grintale 's eyes light up the moment anyone enters its territory. This is no figure of speech—its eyes literally light up. Partner Skill : Glaring Cat's Eye

pals.name: Loupmoon
pals.summary: The horns on its head grow under the moonlight. It doesn't hate the sun, but its horns itch when sunlight hits them. Partner Skill : Dark Gleam Strike

pals.name: Dinossom
pals.summary: A Pal who once angered cannot be pacified. It rages on and on like an inferno. The phrase |step on a Dinossom 's tail| has come to mean enraging someone. Partner Skill : Fragrant Dragon

pals.name: Lovander
pals.summary: Seeking a night of love, it is always chasing someone around. At first it only showed interest in other Pals, but in recent years even humans have become the target of its debauchery. Partner Skill : Heart Drain

pals.name: Wixen
pals.summary: With the power of light, it produces arcane phenomena. It prefers to eat food well-done and is particularly hostile towards Katress . Partner Skill : Lord Fox

pals.name: Penking

spawns.location: Sealed Realm of the Frozen Wings 114,-352

pals.summary: Surprisingly, it is unrelated to Pengullet . However, since this Pal gets pampered as it pleases, for now, it's doing its best to strut arrogantly. Partner Skill : Brave Sailor

pals.name: Mossanda
pals.summary: A Pal so powerful it's hard to believe. In one experiment, this Pal tore through 3,000 sheets of paper at once! It's only by some miracle that this Pal isn't a meat-eater. Partner Skill : Grenadier Panda

pals.name: Robinquill Terra
pals.summary: A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the rocky areas. When Robinquill Terra bones are found in ruins, there are always human bones found nearby as well. Partner Skill : Master Archer

pals.name: Katress

spawns.location: Map Hidden Passage to the Oculus Gate -1083,-1287

pals.summary: With the power of shadows, it produces arcane phenomena. It prefers to eat food raw and is particularly hostile towards Wixen . Partner Skill : Mystical Black Magic

pals.name: Woolipop Terra
pals.summary: Its fur emits a sweet smell, but its meat is disgustingly bitter. Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent into taking a bite will find themselves overwhelmed by the foul taste and pass out. Partner Skill : Bitter Pop

pals.name: Elgrove
pals.summary: The leaf on its horn cannot be removed, no matter how hard it is pulled. When the leaf falls on its own, Elgrove accepts its time has come. Partner Skill : Mother Nature's Menace

pals.name: Lunaris
pals.summary: It can control those who carelessly stare into its eyes. Those seen with a Lunaris are in its mind, simply under its control. Partner Skill : Antigravity

pals.name: Souffline
pals.summary: Its fluff can be used to hide away unpleasant memories. Once carried off by the wind, you can bid farewell to the darkness they carried. Partner Skill : Fuzzy Fairy

pals.name: Lullu
pals.summary: In early spring, pollen floats on the wind throughout the island. Flopie 's hay fever is Lullu 's fault. Partner Skill : Floral Boost

pals.name: Pyrin
pals.summary: Its entire body has evolved into a highly efficient radiator, gifting it with astounding stamina. If someone rides it, this Pal takes caution not to burn them. Partner Skill : Red Hare

pals.name: Foxcicle
pals.summary: On nights when the aurora is visible, it looks up towards the sky and begins to howl a beautiful song. This does, however, leave it vulnerable to attacks from enemies. Partner Skill : Aurora Guide

pals.name: Fenglope
pals.summary: In ages past, its beautiful visage was a common sight in paintings. As time passed, its beautiful pelt and antlers were often seen in works of art. Partner Skill : Wind and Clouds

pals.name: Chillet Ignis
pals.summary: It can curl up its body and roll around so fast that sparks fly. Sparks also fly when it feels excited. If you stroke it too much, this pal will get fired up, literally! Partner Skill : Sparkling Weasel

pals.name: Caprity Noct
pals.summary: The berries that grow on its back change flavor according to its emotions. The harsher the environment it grows in, the sweeter the berries become. This is why most Caprity Noct raised in captivity have never known love. Partner Skill : Venom Picker

pals.name: Reindrix
pals.summary: Its transparent cerulean antlers glow with the cold of absolute zero. Any who touch them with their bare hands are instantly frozen and smashed to pieces. Partner Skill : Cool Body

pals.name: Rayhound
pals.summary: At full speed, it could be mistaken for a bolt of lightning. When two Rayhound s collide, a thunderous roar echoes through the air. Partner Skill : Lightning Shepherd

pals.name: Dazzi Noct
pals.summary: Often kind to lonely Pals, it plots to lure them into dropping their guard before striking them down. Yet, unable to find the right moment, it ends up making friends with them instead. Partner Skill : Lady of Dark Lightning

pals.name: Valentail
pals.summary: In older paintings, it is depicted as much smaller than it is today. For reasons unknown, various parts of its body have begun to elongate rapidly in recent years, and it is predicted to reach nearly ten times its current size within the next century. Partner Skill : Big Stretch

pals.name: Dinossom Lux
pals.summary: Though struck by lightning, it lives on. The phrase |struck by a Dinossom Lux 's bolt| has come to mean narrowly escaping death. Partner Skill : Thunder Dragon

pals.name: Gorirat Terra
pals.summary: It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades. Stronger than Gorirat , if every Gorirat Terra hit the ground at the same time, the island would sink in 1 second. Partner Skill : Full-Power Gorilla Pound

pals.name: Pyrin Noct
pals.summary: It burns mysterious dark matter as energy and expels the remaining particles from its body. If someone rides it, they should take care so as not to gallop down the path of darkness. Partner Skill : Black Hare

pals.name: Croajiro Noct
pals.summary: The Croajiro who have forsaken their honor gather and form splinter groups. They will use any underhanded means to take down their chosen prey. If you encounter a pack of Croajiro Noct in the dead of the night, it's your life that's on the line. Partner Skill : Shadow Stance

pals.name: Penking Lux
pals.summary: Its body changed color after gaining electricity to improve underwater hunting. As a result, it lost the affection of Pengullet — but strangely enough, it now has a loyal follower: Pengullet Lux . Partner Skill : Unyielding Storm Commander

pals.name: Surfent Terra
pals.summary: Its aerodynamic form is well suited for activities on sand. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards. Partner Skill : Sand Swimmer

pals.name: Azurobe
pals.summary: This Pal's white ribbon turns black if doused with impure water. Given its usefulness in detecting poison, this Pal was once overhunted. This past has left them bitter towards humanity. Partner Skill : Waterwing Dance

pals.name: Xenovader
pals.summary: Partner Skill :

pals.name: Sibelyx
pals.summary: A Pal that likes the rain, and will often bask in rain showers until the weather clears up. On rainy days, Foxparks can often be found taking shelter beneath it. Partner Skill : Silk Shroud

pals.name: Katress Ignis
pals.summary: Due to its upbringing, it no longer cares about whether its food is raw enough. This Pal stopped worrying about those details, and just prefers its food to be as spicy as possible. Not on good terms with Wixen Noct . Partner Skill : Blazing Black Magic

pals.name: Elizabee
pals.summary: A chosen queen to rule over Beegarde s. There is a never ending stream of servants willing to work themselves to death for the pleasure of serving their queen. Partner Skill : Queen Bee Command

pals.name: Snock
pals.summary: Tossing an Snock into the bath for a shock spa is considered a traditional health practice. That is to say, the results may be rather shocking. Partner Skill : Charging Shell

pals.name: Hoodle
pals.summary: When it sleeps, it deflates. When it sleeps, it's no longer there. A sleeping Hoodle cannot exist; Therefore, Hoodle never sleeps. Partner Skill : Void-Dweller

pals.name: Smokie
pals.summary: The black flames are merely warm to the touch, but anything left in contact with them slowly melts from the inside. Hold some cheese over them, and it becomes a true delicacy. Partner Skill : Dig, Smokie! Dig!

pals.name: Slowatt
pals.summary: Doing as they please, sleeping when they wish, and eating whatever they like. Surely, Slowatt must be toiling in secret to maintain such a luxury. ...Or so the old islanders told themselves, just to get by. Partner Skill : Chillswitch

pals.name: Mimog
pals.summary: There was once a tradition of handing out an award to the person who met their end in the most foolish way. The first award was given for |being unaware of Mimog , opening the chest, and being bitten to death.| Partner Skill : Master of Unlocking

pals.name: Tarantriss
pals.summary: Extremely sticky and clingy. The more it's resisted, the more tenacious it becomes. Such is its |personality.| Partner Skill : Tarantriss’ Web

pals.name: Petallia
pals.summary: A Pal that transforms into a massive plant when at the end of its life. Once every ten years, a beautiful flower blooms and a new Petallia is born. Partner Skill : Blessing of the Flower Spirit

pals.name: Maraith
pals.summary: It relishes the peculiar scent living things give off when they are near death. If a Maraith has taken a liking to you, it is safe to assume that is why. Partner Skill : Messenger of Death

pals.name: Carnibora
pals.summary: Prone to eating indiscriminately, the mouth atop its head frequently breaks out in agonizing ulcers, causing it to use the mouth on its face instead. However, its behavior doesn't change, which leads to both mouths suffering the same ulcers. Partner Skill : Entangling Tongue

pals.name: Beakon
pals.summary: Some think it is a related species to Ragnahawk , but there is in fact no connection. Using its sharp beak, it descends on its prey in a quick motion that resembles a bolt of lightning. Partner Skill : Thunderous

pals.name: Lapiron
pals.summary: Listens to the earth as it runs, avoiding unstable footing with ease. However, uncooperative terrain will trick it into falling over constantly. Partner Skill : Friend of Earth

pals.name: Kitsun
pals.summary: Despite its appearance, Kitsun is extremely sensitive and will flee into a cave when spooked. Long ago, it was considered an ill omen if one ran away from you. Partner Skill : Wolf of the Sun

pals.name: Polapup
pals.summary: Among Polapup s, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect. Sometimes, a too-forceful leap sends one tumbling from the sky— a common sight during territorial season. Forecast: clear skies with a chance of flying Polapup s. Partner Skill : Rider of the Snowy Mountain

pals.name: Vanwyrm
pals.summary: The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm are said to cross whole mountain ranges. In ages past, such flutes were used to signal an attack. Partner Skill : Aerial Marauder

pals.name: Elphidran Aqua
pals.summary: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it harbors no ill will in any of its actions and is indifferent even after killing someone. Partner Skill : Amicable Water Dragon

pals.name: Gloopie Primo
pals.summary: Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal. Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like bite marks. One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some truly unnecessary concern. Partner Skill : Cephalo-Princess

pals.name: Dumud Gild
pals.summary: Its body reflects light with astounding clarity. Even more shocking, its reflexes are somehow even slower than Dumud . Partner Skill : Golden Harvest

pals.name: Smokie Cryst
pals.summary: The blue flames are merely cool to the touch, but anything left in contact with them slowly freezes. Hold a milk bottle over them, and you get a frozen milkshake! Partner Skill : Cryo Instincts

pals.name: Rayhound Cryst
pals.summary: Sprinting across the tundra at full speed kicks up a blinding blizzard, leading to constant Rayhound Cryst collisions due to zero visibility. Partner Skill : Snow Shepherd

pals.name: Skutlass Ignis
pals.summary: A bizarre species which temporarily separates its body and uses its bones to slice through enemies, at the risk of perishing itself upon taking too long. While unconfirmed, older individuals are said to deliberately stay separated in order to trigger their survival instincts and prolong their lifespans. Partner Skill : Seared Fish Fillet

pals.name: Needoll Noct
pals.summary: Its spikes react to its emotions. A well-loved Needoll Noct clings to its owner, but accepting that love means accepting the pain too. Partner Skill : Hug You So Much

pals.name: Felbat
pals.summary: Attacking from the shadows, this Pal traps its prey within its cloak-like wings. It's probably best not to know what happens within them, or why the inside of its wings are stained red. Partner Skill : Life Steal

pals.name: Bushi
pals.summary: Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation. If someone other than a Bushi wields this blade, the soul within torments them until they are driven mad. Partner Skill : Brandish Blade

pals.name: Digtoise
pals.summary: A Digtoise possessing the strongest shell and the only drill capable of piercing it, ponders the contradictions of the world in the popular children's tale, | Digtoise 's Fable|. Partner Skill : Drill Crusher

pals.name: Bakemi
pals.summary: It lives entirely for the thrill of the scare, but is utterly un-frightening. As most cannot help but indulge it with feigned surprise for its cuteness, Bakemi now leaves a trail of smiles in its wake. Partner Skill : Grinning Death

pals.name: Kingpaca Cryst
pals.summary: With a heart of ice, this Pal is terrible at expressing its emotions. A solitary individual is pitiable, seen as too clumsy in the eyes of a Melpaca . Partner Skill : Coldhearted King

pals.name: Shroomer
pals.summary: Inhaling large amounts of its spores will put you into a trance. Sometimes, if Shroomer appears motionless, it's not because it's mimicking a mushroom, but rather because it's high off its own spores. Partner Skill : Rampant Spores

pals.name: Prixter
pals.summary: It has about 5,000 types of venom. Some of them are deadly enough to cause instant death, but none are present in a high enough concentration to have any effect. Partner Skill : Phantom Venom

pals.name: Snock Lux
pals.summary: Tossing a heated Snock Lux into the bath for a scorching spa was once a fad of the distant past. Owing to a recent revival, it is now quite literally a hot trend. Partner Skill : Grounding Shell

pals.name: Wixen Noct
pals.summary: Due to its upbringing, it no longer cares about whether its food is cooked enough. This Pal stopped worrying about those details, and just prefers its food to be as sweet as possible. Not on good terms with Katress Ignis . Partner Skill : Black Fox Lord

pals.name: Vaelet
pals.summary: The castle was filled with the king's favorite flowers. A great battle ensued, and flames approached the castle. Amidst the chaos, the spirit of a flower appeared. - From the fairy tale, |The King's Flower.| Partner Skill : Purification of Gaia

pals.name: Incineram
pals.summary: In the dark of night, this Pal snatches prey to bring back to its territory. What happens to those poor souls afterwards isn't too hard to imagine. Partner Skill : Flameclaw Hunter

pals.name: Dogen
pals.summary: Striving for a state of selflessness, it meditates endlessly. After confronting its worldly desires, it eats a meal and reflects. It ate too much today. Partner Skill : Homeward Prayer

pals.name: Shroomer Noct
pals.summary: The abundance of spores released by this Pal blocks out sunlight. Sometimes, if Shroomer Noct appears motionless, it's not because it's mimicking a mushroom, but rather because its own spores don't let it see anything. Partner Skill : Roiling Spores

pals.name: Mossanda Lux
pals.summary: Partner Skill :

pals.name: Vanwyrm Cryst
pals.summary: The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm Cryst are said to cross whole mountain ranges. In ages past, such flutes were used to signal victory in battle. Partner Skill : Aerial Marauder

pals.name: Skutlass
pals.summary: A bizarre species which temporarily separates its body and uses its bones to slice through enemies, at the risk of perishing itself upon taking too long. While unconfirmed, older individuals are said to deliberately stay separated in order to trigger their survival instincts and prolong their lifespans. Partner Skill : Fish Fillet

pals.name: Leafan
pals.summary: To hone the martial art passed down through a single bloodline: Daily training is the only way! Being distracted by romance? Unthinkable! Daily discipline is the only way! The time has come! Shoot my shot! Instant rejection, that’s all there is! The techniques of love were never passed down... Lingering regret, that’s all there is! Partner Skill : Selfless Discipline

pals.name: Dynamoff
pals.summary: With so little to eat at high altitudes, it will occasionally even feast on its enemies' brains. It is thought that groups seeking a more dependable food source descended to lower skies, ultimately diverging into Beakon . Partner Skill : Electro-Massage Incubation

pals.name: Prunelia
pals.summary: Intelligent and graceful in its demeanor, it was frequently employed as an attendant by the island's nobles. However, when encountered at night, its face looked so eerie that it quickly fell out of favor. Partner Skill : Prayer for Abundant Harvest

pals.name: Broncherry
pals.summary: Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing. It exudes a pleasing aroma after finding a partner, which is called the |Fragrance of First Love.| Partner Skill : Love's First Blossom

pals.name: Solmora
pals.summary: Its corkscrew tail acts as a propeller. Research claims that if its body could withstand the strain, it could reach speeds beyond 88 mph. Partner Skill : Charming Fish

pals.name: Blazehowl

spawns.location: Sealed Realm of the Myriad Flames -256,-131

pals.summary: While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating well-done meat. This is due to its blistering claws, which it uses as its weapon—it simply doesn't realize its prey gets burned to a crisp. Partner Skill : Hellflame Lion

pals.name: Tropicaw
pals.summary: While some say that it flails around to mimic flowers swaying in the wind and avoid predators, others argue that a crimson flower thrashing violently at high speeds is simply so unsettling that nothing dares approach it. Partner Skill : Flower Dance

pals.name: Mammorest
pals.summary: The vegetation on its back varies between individuals. There is a long history of appreciating this veritable garden of a Pal, and there are even Mammorest pruning specialists. Partner Skill : Gaia Crusher

pals.name: Turtacle Terra
pals.summary: To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell. With most of its senses concentrated in its limbs and shell, it can’t even tell if someone quietly touches its core. Partner Skill : Shiny Hauler

pals.name: Nitemary Botan
pals.summary: What it carries is its own soul. When it falls for someone, it flings its soul at them to merge it with theirs, yearning to become one. Partner Skill : Soul Binder

pals.name: Incineram Noct

spawns.location: Map Sealed Realm of the Frozen Wings 159,-286

pals.summary: Partner Skill :

pals.name: Quivern Botan
pals.summary: When you hug Quivern Botan , if it smells like sunshine and meadows, tomorrow will be sunny. If it smells damp, tomorrow will be wet and miserable. Partner Skill : Grass Dragon Affection

pals.name: Loupmoon Cryst
pals.summary: The horns on its head are made of a mysterious ice that never melts. Shaved ice made by breaking off a horn is truly exquisite, but both the one who tries it and Loupmoon Cryst end up with a headache. Partner Skill : Frozen Gleam Strike

pals.name: Warsect
pals.summary: The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is extremely strong and heat resistant. Even a napalm blast would hardly leave a scratch. Partner Skill : Cast-Iron Shell

pals.name: Blazehowl Noct
pals.summary: While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating tainted meat. This is due to its dark claws, which it uses as its weapon—it simply doesn't realize its prey gets cursed. Partner Skill : Darkflame Lion

pals.name: Icelyn
pals.summary: Though its body melts in the heat, it just can’t resist sunbathing. Though its body melts in the warmth, it likes hot springs too much. If it's going to melt anyway, it hopes it’ll be in a steaming outdoor bath under a clear blue sky. Partner Skill : Witch's Icy Veil

pals.name: Nyafia
pals.summary: Strongly dislikes anyone catching a glimpse of its concealed eye. If you insist on trying, it'll burst into tears and ignore you for two weeks. Partner Skill : Shot-Nyan Mode

pals.name: Palumba
pals.summary: Disrupts enemies’ rhythm with a signature dance. In turf battles, the first to fall in sync with the other’s rhythm loses. Courtship, boredom, battle—it all comes down to dance! Now then, what could a dance aimed at a human possibly mean? Partner Skill : Samba Step

pals.name: Nitemary
pals.summary: What it carries is its own soul. When it falls for someone, it forcibly extracts their soul and merges it with its own, yearning to become one. Partner Skill : Soul Collector

pals.name: Azurobe Cryst
pals.summary: This Pal’s white ribbon continuously absorbs heat from its surroundings, yet its temperature remains curiously unchanged. This strange ability once made it a target of relentless hunting, leaving it with a deep mistrust of humans to this day. Partner Skill : Icewing Dance

pals.name: Quivern
pals.summary: Sleeping while cuddling a Quivern is said to be a heavenly experience, but there are some who have been crushed and sent to heaven by ones that toss and turn in their sleep. Partner Skill : Sky Dragon Affection

pals.name: Suzaku
pals.summary: It was once believed to usher in the dry season. Whenever there was a drought the previous year, people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers, hoping to bring about a plentiful harvest in the next year. Partner Skill : Wings of Flame

pals.name: Bulldosu
pals.summary: In the old islands, Bulldosu sumo was widely enjoyed. At the highest levels, even a charging Rushoar would be sent flying instead. Partner Skill : Yokozuna's Presence

pals.name: Wistella
pals.summary: At the end of its life, a new star appears somewhere in the skies, glowing with the weight of its memories. Partner Skill : Hidden Dark Energy

pals.name: Gildra
pals.summary: The golden, bandage-like organs covering its body are highly elastic. However, they are prone to tearing under extremely dry conditions, so daily moisture checks are absolutely essential. Partner Skill : Resurrection

pals.name: Verdash
pals.summary: Land that Verdash has run across becomes extremely fertile, with thick vegetation growing soon after. It will not run anywhere that herbicide has been used. Partner Skill : Grassland Gymnast

pals.name: Starryon
pals.summary: It takes great pride in its flowing, gorgeous mane. If it finds a split end, it becomes so mortified it can't focus on running properly. Because static electricity makes its hair frizzy, it avoids Azurmane at all costs. Partner Skill : Night Dancer

pals.name: Omascul
pals.summary: The mask it wears is not its face, they say. It seems in front, but it's not there, no way. From shadows deep, it watches night and day. Glance away, and closer it will stray. Partner Skill : Masquerade Dance

pals.name: Helzephyr
pals.summary: Partner Skill :

pals.name: Menasting
pals.summary: Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow. This Pal crams still-living prey into its hollow body, where it absorbs them. Hellish screams of pain can often be heard coming from inside this Pal. Partner Skill : Steel Scorpion

pals.name: Pierdon
pals.summary: It smashes its body against harder rocks to maintain its preferred shape. Those with noticeable dents are best left alone, much like people with a botched haircut. Partner Skill : Power Stone

pals.name: Polapup Terra
pals.summary: Among Polapup Terra s, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect. Sometimes, a too-forceful leap leaves one buried in the snow— a common sight during particularly competitive seasons. Traffic forecast: heavy Polapup Terra congestion. Partner Skill : Snowy Mountain Slider

pals.name: Relaxaurus
pals.summary: Contrary to its blasé appearance, it's quite ferocious. It perceives everything in its sight as prey and will stop at nothing to devour it. Partner Skill : Hungry Missile

pals.name: Broncherry Aqua
pals.summary: Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing. It exudes a pleasing aroma before finding a partner, which is called the |Perfume of Purity.| Partner Skill : Purity's Full Bloom

pals.name: Mammorest Cryst
pals.summary: The vegetation on its back varies between individuals. There was a time when seeds of presumed extinct plants were found still frozen on the back of a Mammorest Cryst . Partner Skill : Ice Crusher

pals.name: Reptyro
pals.summary: Magma-like blood runs throughout its body. If a large amount of water is thrown on it, the water rapidly heats, causing an immense vapor explosion. Partner Skill : Ore-Loving Beast

pals.name: Ragnahawk
pals.summary: Some think it is a related species to Beakon , but there is in fact no connection. It mainly eats rocks, and after many long years its beak and head have hardened to accommodate this diet. Partner Skill : Flame Wing

pals.name: Cryolinx
pals.summary: It can easily climb steep mountains with its hard claws. However, its short legs make it difficult to descend, often leaving it stranded in high places. Partner Skill : Dragon Hunter

pals.name: Braloha
pals.summary: Its breath carries a miraculous, pollen-like substance that pollinates any plant it touches. For plant-based Pals, being near it can be a bit… complicated. Partner Skill : Balmy Weather

pals.name: Grizzbolt

spawns.location: Map Sea Breeze Archipelago - Castaway Beach 56,-697

pals.summary: With a friendly smile and a hardy physique, it is docile towards one it recognizes as a partner. For reasons unexplained, its personality undergoes a drastic change when wielding a minigun. Partner Skill : Yellow Tank

pals.name: Majex
pals.summary: It appears to be striking a heroic pose, but the reality is that it's simply bracing itself against the weight of its tail and hair to avoid toppling over. Partner Skill : Phantasmal Arcana

pals.name: Solmora Lux
pals.summary: Its corkscrew tail acts as a propeller. Research claims that if its body could withstand the strain, it could generate over 1.21 gigawatts of power. Partner Skill : Shocking Fish

pals.name: Xenogard
pals.summary: Partner Skill :

pals.name: Sootseer
pals.summary: It was once believed that as the world approached its end, the flame would weaken. Doomsayers would repeatedly rejoice when the flame began to weaken, but in the end, it turned out to be a prank by Sootseer . At least, for now. Partner Skill : Grave Robber

pals.name: Venusa
pals.summary: Whenever it's confused, it resorts to consulting with the snakes on its head. However, since they're all ultimately the same being, it comes to understand that nothing is understood. Partner Skill : Snake's Sagacity

pals.name: Helzephyr Lux
pals.summary: It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell. While considered a subspecies of Helzephyr , there's a theory that suggests Helzephyr Lux , struck by lightning from hell, will transform into Helzephyr . Partner Skill : Wings of Thunder

pals.name: Fenglope Lux
pals.summary: In ages past, it was believed that drawing a picture of Fenglope Lux would result in being struck down by lightning. As time passes, artworks depicting Fenglope Lux became revered as charms to ward off lightning, making them a common presence. Partner Skill : Stormcloud

pals.name: Loomen
pals.summary: Its lantern glows with an eerie light that lays bare the truth of the world. If that light strikes you as blinding, then you most likely have something to hide. Partner Skill : Lantern Enchantment

pals.name: Ghangler
pals.summary: With its shining lure, it illuminates the darkness. The wandering Pals drawn in by the light stand no chance of escape once spotted by Ghangler . No matter how far, it will keep guiding them until they get home safe and sound. Partner Skill : Master of Darkness

pals.name: Sekhmet
pals.summary: Once a fierce creature feared as a symbol of death. When Anubis claimed that mantle, wealthy elites looking for a replacement beguiled the species with wine. Before long, Sekhmet became a symbol of high nobility. Partner Skill : Desert Empress

pals.name: Frostplume
pals.summary: So precise is its sense of time that it awakens at the exact same hour every morning. According to Palpagos lore, a day was divided into 24 parts because when Frostplume spreads its tail feathers wide, it reveals a pattern with 24 distinct spaces. Partner Skill : Peacock Pounce

pals.name: Prixter Lux
pals.summary: It pierces foes with its tail to deliver an electric jolt directly into their bodies. However, the current it generates is extremely weak, so a simple punch would do far more damage. Partner Skill : Scorpion Longwave

pals.name: Bushi Noct
pals.summary: Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation. If the Bushi who inherits it has a weak heart, the voices of the dead will drive it mad. The madness turns it into Bushi Noct that endlessly wanders. Partner Skill : Void Blade

pals.name: Wumpo
pals.summary: Researchers once tried to shave off its hair to reveal its true form. In the end, only hair was left, as if that was all there was to begin with. Partner Skill : Guardian of the Snowy Mountain

pals.name: Petallia Ignis
pals.summary: A Pal that burns away into a pile of ash upon the end of its life. The surrounding soil becomes incredibly fertile, allowing an abundance of vegetation to thrive for the following decade. Partner Skill : Passion of the Flower Spirit

pals.name: Lapure
pals.summary: It uses the long, flowing fur on its hands to attract attention, always taking the utmost care to keep them maintained. Highly sensitive to dirt and meticulously clean, kicking up dust nearby will invite a very disgusted glare. Partner Skill : Long-Sleeved Hurray

pals.name: Kitsun Noct
pals.summary: Partner Skill :

pals.name: Tetroise
pals.summary: Those stones on its back are not just cargo. Set them down somewhere distant and they will slowly make their way back home. Partner Skill : Masonry Archelon

pals.name: Splatterina
pals.summary: It has an uncontrollable urge to tear its prey apart. Each individual has their own meticulous order for dismemberment. If caught by Splatterina , pray that your head is taken first. Partner Skill : Blade of Uncontrolled Passion

pals.name: Relaxaurus Lux
pals.summary: Partner Skill :

pals.name: Mycora
pals.summary: It views humans as nothing more than convenient parasitic hosts. The reason Mycora has taken this form is to deceive humans into lowering their guard, allowing its spores to spread more efficiently. Partner Skill : Charming Spore

pals.name: Moldron
pals.summary: In a healthy individual, the lava on its back flows smoothly. However, a poor lifestyle will gradually worsen its circulation, eventually causing a lava clog that results in a sudden, massive explosion. Partner Skill : Magma Overload

pals.name: Suzaku Aqua
pals.summary: It was once believed to usher in the rainy season. Whenever there was a flood the previous year, people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers, hoping to avert disaster in the coming year. Partner Skill : Wings of Water

pals.name: Gildane
pals.summary: During the golden age of alchemy on the island, its ever-glowing golden fur was highly prized as a catalyst for transmuting gold. In time, a remarkable revelation was made: the same golden hue could be achieved simply by processing its mane. Partner Skill : Sandstorm's Blessing

pals.name: Ghangler Ignis
pals.summary: Its blazing lure doubles as a grill for roasting prey. Drawn in by the delicious aroma, Pals have no hope of escape once Ghangler Ignis sets its sights on them. In the end, they’re treated to a hearty meal—until everyone’s full. Partner Skill : Abyssal Celebrity Chef

pals.name: Whalaska
pals.summary: When it sleeps, Pals often mistake it for a drifting piece of ice and rest on it. Although gentle and unwilling to push them away when awake, it feels quietly stressed by the intrusion on its personal space. Partner Skill : Chilled Whale Cruiser

pals.name: Sibelyx Primo
pals.summary: A Pal that loves gazing into the void, and will often remain completely still. It frequently becomes a gathering spot for smaller Pals. Partner Skill : Gilded Shroud

pals.name: Menasting Terra
pals.summary: Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow. It stuffs earth and minerals into its outer shell, achieving overwhelming mass. Those who are struck by it can only let out hellish groans. Partner Skill : Golden Scorpion

pals.name: Warsect Terra

spawns.location: Map Hidden Passage to the Oculus Gate -1019,-1236

pals.summary: The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is extremely strong and heat resistant. It doesn't flinch even if a Mammorest steps on it. Partner Skill : Fullmetal Shell

pals.name: Bellanoir
pals.summary: Without existing, she quietly gazed upon the world. One day, she was seized with a longing to be seen. With unbridled lust for vengeance against reality, thus was born the Eclipsed Siren. Partner Skill : Nightmare Iris

pals.name: Wumpo Botan
pals.summary: Researchers once tried to cut the grass off its body to reveal its true form. In the end, only grass was left, as if that was all there was to begin with. Partner Skill : Guardian of the South

pals.name: Reptyro Cryst
pals.summary: Ice cold blood runs throughout its body. If heated rapidly, its blood evaporates, causing an immense vapor explosion. Partner Skill : Ice-Loving Beast

pals.name: Jormuntide
pals.summary: Legend says the Jormuntide was once a wise man who, after being wrongly convicted and cast into a whirlpool, returned as this Pal to annihilate the kingdom. Partner Skill : Stormbringer Sea Dragon

pals.name: Beakon Cryst
pals.summary: Perfectly adapted to colder environments, it hardly feels the cold despite its slender form. Its diving plunge carries tremendous force, as if a giant icicle were dropping straight from the sky. Partner Skill : Coldsnap

pals.name: Celesdir

spawns.location: Map The Oculus Gate, Tower in Sight -1048,-1358

pals.summary: Ancient texts refer to it as the |Beast of Salvation.| The light emitted by Celesdir purifies everything, literally causing things to vanish from existence without leaving a trace. Partner Skill : Blessing of Purification

pals.name: Silvegis
pals.summary: The metallic components around its neck possess magnetic properties. If the leg pieces get too close, they cling to it. When metal debris builds up on its neck, it grudgingly begins cleaning, and grows frustrated when they won't come off easily. Partner Skill : Aegis Shield

pals.name: Shadowbeak
pals.summary: Born from the depths of insanity, its very existence defies reason. Having lost all genetic ties to other Pals, one wonders if it could still even be considered a Pal. Partner Skill : Modified DNA

pals.name: Univolt Cryst
pals.summary: It used to be considered an emissary of the Winter God, and thus was not hunted by people. However, after witnesses observed one lose its footing on the ice, its reverence faded, and it quite literally slid into the role of a workhorse. Partner Skill : Frigid Deity

pals.name: Roujay
pals.summary: A thief by nature, it snatches items when no one is looking. No reason to be concerned when caught in the act. Once it swiftly steals your eyes, you won’t be seeing anything anyway. Partner Skill : Dark-Nester

pals.name: Dupin
pals.summary: A copy it created might quietly replace it, leaving even the Dupin itself unsure whether it is still the original. Partner Skill : Trick-Loving Fluffle

pals.name: Dualith
pals.summary: One entity, two minds. When their wills clash, it's impossible to tell where the armor will wander until they reconcile. Partner Skill : Forest Laser

pals.name: Faleris
pals.summary: Partner Skill :

pals.name: Astegon
pals.summary: A savage beast born of the abyss. Thou shall not stand before the beast. Thou shall not heed the beast. Partner Skill : Black Ankylosaur

pals.name: Anubis
pals.summary: Once seen as a symbol of nobility, and an idol for those who shunned wealth and power. Yet over time, this Pal became a token of death. Partner Skill : Guardian of the Desert

pals.name: Cryolinx Terra
pals.summary: It can easily carry many items with its large hands. However, its short legs slow its pace, often leaving it overtaken by nightfall. Partner Skill : Explosive Strength

pals.name: Pierdon Cryst
pals.summary: It basks in the sun, rotating just enough to melt its ice into its preferred shape. Lopsided ones should be left alone, much like a person who was a little too bold with their sideburns. Partner Skill : Power Crystal

pals.name: Faleris Aqua
pals.summary: When it finds its prey, it unleashes a mighty torrent, sweeping the entire area. More often than not, the prey gets swept away in the chaos, leaving one to wonder whether this truly counts as hunting. Partner Skill : Tidal Predator

pals.name: Elgrove Cryst
pals.summary: Its frozen horn stays solid through its life. When water begins to drip from this ice, Elgrove Cryst feels the chill of its own life slipping away. Partner Skill : Father Winter's Threat

pals.name: Starryon Primo
pals.summary: It takes great pride in its glowing, gorgeous mane. If it gets even slightly dirty, it becomes so mortified it can't focus on running properly. Because skin oils ruin its coat, it wants to avoid being touched too much, even by its favorite Pal Tamer. Partner Skill : Light Dancer

pals.name: Azurmane
pals.summary: Like Univolt , it was once believed to be connected to the Thunder God. As faith in Univolt waned, Azurmane was deemed the God's true envoy. Even so, time reduced both to the same lowly status of ordinary workhorses. Partner Skill : Plasma Dash

pals.name: Blazamut
pals.summary: Legends say it was born during a volcanic eruption. A strange group even claims that this continent is laid upon the back of a giant Blazamut . Partner Skill : Magma Kaiser

pals.name: Xenolord
pals.summary: -Destination reached. Priority: Locate entity |Supersonic Dragon| -Note: Conquest deadline exceeded by years. -Update: No conquest traces found. Naturalization confirmed. Commence elimination protocol. -Staff Memo: Refrain from forgetting or consuming critical data! Partner Skill : Meteor Wings

pals.name: Flaracle
pals.summary: It focuses its mind and reads the future through flames. Should it glimpse an inconvenient destiny, it relentlessly rerolls the prophecy until it gets a favorable result. That is why the future of Flaracle is always exceptionally bright! Partner Skill : Burning Future

pals.name: Moldron Cryst
pals.summary: In a healthy individual, the substance flowing along its back maintains a stable temperature. However, if its heartbeat quickens, the temperature destabilizes, eventually triggering vaporization or crystallization that results in a sudden, abrupt death from shock. Partner Skill : Ice Overload

pals.name: Whalaska Ignis
pals.summary: Determined never to be mistaken for drift ice again, it turned bright red through sheer will. Unfortunately, some Pals can’t see red. So despite its efforts, its personal space continues to be invaded. Partner Skill : Cozy Whale Cruiser

pals.name: Selyne
pals.summary: Partner Skill :

pals.name: Eidrolon
pals.summary: A new Pal that was only recently discovered. Calm and entirely docile, it spends its time as it pleases. It is no longer bound by anything. Partner Skill : Liberated Pterosaur

pals.name: Renjishi
pals.summary: At a glance, its movements appear exaggerated and full of openings. Strangely, however, any opponents become overwhelmed, and become unable to look away, as if transfixed. Partner Skill : Stage Combat

pals.name: Solenne
pals.summary: Joy and misery come in equal measure for Solenne . Those who choose to take care of one must be prepared for what that entails. Partner Skill : Untainted Maiden

pals.name: Celesdir Noct
pals.summary: Where blinding radiance shines, dark shadows are born. It scatters an all-enveloping darkness to reclaim the chaos that ought to be. Balance is what the world requires. Partner Skill : Blessing of Chaos

pals.name: Knocklem
pals.summary: Partner Skill :

pals.name: Dualith Noct
pals.summary: One entity, two minds. They rarely agree and bicker constantly, but once battle begins, mind and body instantly unite as one! Partner Skill : Corruption Laser

pals.name: Lyleen
pals.summary: A docile Pal full of love. It watches over small Pals who have lost their parents. It uses a full-power Solar Blast to discipline naughty Pals. Partner Skill : Harvest Goddess

pals.name: Ophydia
pals.summary: Waters where Ophydia s dwell are often filled with flowers that mimic its form. Many attempts have been made to directly propagate these blooms, but they inevitably wither the moment human hands interfere. Partner Skill : Glorious Mist

pals.name: Lyleen Noct
pals.summary: An elegant Pal full of grace. It admonishes any who are disrespectful with a painful slap. Some Pals actively seek out this punishment. Partner Skill : Goddess of the Tranquil Light

pals.name: Knocklem Ignis
pals.summary: Upon disassembly, it is capable of being reassembled and functioning again. Mixing parts from different individuals will trigger a fatal cognitive error that causes its systems to overheat. Partner Skill : Iron Guardian Mode

pals.name: Tetroise Primo

spawns.location: The Oculus Gate, Tower in Sight -1082,-1320

pals.summary: Even if the stones on its back were to be removed, Tetroise Primo will know where they are. No matter how far apart, it will always track them down. Partner Skill : Stone-Chaser Archelon

pals.name: Necromus
pals.summary: Once one with Paladius . Its darkened form is the embodiment of negative emotions. However, a glimmer of compassion can still be seen deep within its eyes. Partner Skill : Dark Knight of the Abyss

pals.name: Paladius
pals.summary: Once one with Necromus . Its gleaming form is free of all negative emotions. However, a glimmer of hatred can still be seen deep within its eyes. Partner Skill : Holy Knight of the Firmament

pals.name: Jormuntide Ignis
pals.summary: Legend says the Jormuntide Ignis was once a warrior who, after being wrongly convicted and cast into a volcano, returned as this Pal to annihilate the kingdom. Partner Skill : Stormbringer Lava Dragon

pals.name: Neptilius
pals.summary: After the sealing of the calamity, a champion from Feybreak emerged. It stares out to sea, awaiting one it deems worthy. For such encounters are no coincidence—they are fate. Partner Skill : Sentinel of the Great Sea

pals.name: Frostallion

spawns.location: Map Garden Beneath the Astral Mountains -357,

pals.summary: Guardian deity of Palpagos Island, known as the Winter Caller. In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky and sealed away the threat by casting the island into eternal winter. Partner Skill : Icy Steed

pals.name: Eidrolon Ignis
pals.summary: A new Pal that was only recently discovered. It trusts nothing and no one, and its tempermental nature leads to it constantly venting its rage at the nearest target. Partner Skill : Resentful Pterosaur

pals.name: Bellanoir Libero
pals.summary: With her desires set loose, she was soon overwhelmed. She longed for a self to gaze upon herself. And the sisters who gazed, resenting reality, were driven into the abyss and, at last, closed their eyes. Partner Skill : Nightmare Stare

pals.name: Orserk
pals.summary: It sends electricity into its foes' wounds, roasting them from the inside out. Fights between Orserk end in the blink of an eye. Partner Skill : Ferocious Thunder Dragon

pals.name: Frostallion Noct
pals.summary: Guardian deity of Palpagos Island, known as the Night Caller. In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky and sealed away the threat by casting the island into eternal darkness. Partner Skill : Black Steed

pals.name: Blazamut Ryu
pals.summary: Long ago, it emerged from the depths of the earth. With relentless, raging flames showing no mercy, it burned the entire island until nothing remained. It was known as the Eternal Flame. Partner Skill : Dragon Kaiser

pals.name: Hartalis
pals.summary: The silence is unsettling, yet strangely soothing. No one else remains. All have been delivered. O King of Salvation, carry me too into eternal stillness. -The ancient text cuts off here. Partner Skill : Sacred Barrier

pals.name: Silvance
pals.summary: Since ancient times, it has remained within the World Tree, continuing its vigil. What it protects, and for what purpose, Silvance does not know. After all, the World Tree will tell it everything. The spores it commands surely know who the enemy is. Partner Skill : Spore Stalwart

pals.name: Jetragon
pals.summary: Watches over Palpagos Island from high above. When calamity returns to the land, the earth will split open, and the skies will burn. It is destined to strike down the calamity in a flash of total destruction. Partner Skill : Aerial Missile

pals.name: Dandilord
pals.summary: Since ancient times, it has remained within the World Tree, continuing its vigil. What it protects, and for what purpose, Dandilord does not care. After all, the World Tree knows everything. Only the mist it wields can reveal the truth. Partner Skill : Mist Stalwart

pals.name: Bastigor
pals.summary: The sight of anything round gives it an uncontrollable urge to punch it. For Bastigor the toughest challenge, after simply living, is making a snowman. Partner Skill : Blizzard Crash

pals.name: Shaolong
pals.summary: Its ring is reserved for a special occasion: upon meeting its destined companion, the rings are traded, a symbol of their eternal partnership. Partner Skill : Azure Sovereign

pals.name: Aegidron
pals.summary: In ancient times, when means of communication were limited, the light within Aegidron 's wings was used to send simple flash signals. Partner Skill : Indestructible Fortress

pals.name: Panthalus
pals.summary: Partner Skill :

pals.name: Astralym
pals.summary: A shadow of its former self, this mysterious Pal descended upon the Palpagos long ago. Bringing ruin and calamity, it was sealed away for millennia until it was ultimately defeated by a certain Pal Tamer Partner Skill : -
